tei:div.tei:p: Blessed art Thou, our Rock, our King and our Redeemer, Creator of holy beings. May Thy Name be extolled for ever, O our King, who has formed the ministering angels; and all His ministering angels stand on the summit of the world and loudly proclaim in awe together the words of the living God and King of the world. All of them are loved, all are selected, all are mighty and all perform in reverence and fear the will of their Creator. All of them open their mouth in sanctity and purity, in song and melody, and bless and praise, glorify and revere, sanctify and crown
